sources.headline_original: Trump bears down on Zelensky as Russia keeps up attacks on Ukraine
key_facts: Announcement came after days of pressure from Trump for Ukraine to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries; Trump blames those strikes for a rise in diesel prices ahead of the midterms
Per a White House official, the proposal would initially require both countries to stop attacking oil refineries
Ukraine objected that 'refinery for refinery' would be unequal given Russia's much larger refining network
Zelensky: Ukraine would halt refinery strikes if Moscow stopped attacking Ukraine's energy infrastructure; any deal needs "real guarantees"

sources.headline_original: Trump claims 'energy ceasefire,' but Ukraine says Russia keeps striking its energy facilities
key_facts: Trump post (same text carried by Fox, CBS, Time): "Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE" ... "Both parties have agreed" ... "Do not break it!"
Zelenskyy said the announcement "was news for me" and reported Russian strikes on energy infrastructure incl. a power plant in Kharkiv
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov: "contacts are ongoing"
Ceasefire followed an Oct. 9 deal in which Trump announced Russia agreed to supply global markets with more than 4.8 million tons of diesel
Average US diesel price Monday $6.26/gallon, nearly 80% higher than at the start of the year (AAA)
